user.title: Select entities
user.description: Choose the entities whose state is sent to the Loxone Miniserver via UDP. You can change this later in the integration options.

data_description.entities: On/off-like states (on, open, home, locked, ...) are sent as 1/0, numeric states as number. Other states are skipped.

data_description.name: Also used as title of the Loxone virtual UDP input.
data_description.port: Must match the port of the virtual UDP input in Loxone Config.
data_description.prefix: Packets look like PREFIX + entity_id + "=" + value, e.g. ha/sensor.temperature=21.5.
data_description.refresh_interval: Resend all values periodically (e.g. after a Miniserver restart). 0 = off.

error.invalid_prefix: The prefix must not contain a backslash or '='.
error.already_configured: This Miniserver (host and port) is already configured.

data_description.prefix: Changing the prefix requires re-importing the template in Loxone Config.

loxone_template.title: Loxone import template
loxone_template.description:
**[Download template]({url})** ({count} entities, port {port})

The link is valid for 30 minutes. If clicking it does not start a download, open it in a new tab.

In Loxone Config: select *Virtual Inputs* → *Virtual UDP Input* → *Import template* and choose the downloaded VIU_*.xml file.

error.invalid_prefix: The prefix must not contain a backslash or '='.
error.already_configured: This Miniserver (host and port) is already configured.
